name: Falcon USD
oneLiner: USDf is Falcon Finance's overcollateralized synthetic dollar minted 1:1 from stablecoins or via dynamic ratios against BTC, ETH, SOL, and altcoin collateral.
collateral: Crypto assets backing USDf and the USDf Earn strategy, with delta-neutral hedging on centralized exchanges; the reviewed composition is ~94% BTC alongside USDC and USDT cash-equivalents, an insurance fund, and a ~2% long-tail of other crypto and tokenized assets. Falcon additionally accepts tokenized real-world assets (USTB, JAAA, JTRSY, tokenized gold and equities, and Etherfuse CETES) as mintable collateral, though no individual tokenized-RWA balance is present in the reviewed reserve composition.
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized synthetic dollar; liquidation mechanisms and arbitrage maintain the $1 peg; delta-neutral strategies power sUSDf yield
